name: Vanguard
description: Stands in front, takes the hits, and keeps the enemy's attention off the healer.

skills.name: Slash
skills.description: A sword slash — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: A sword slash — basic damage.

skills.name: Shield Guard
skills.description: Sets the shield square to the front and plants the feet behind it, and every eye in the room finds it.
skills.shortDescription: Raises a shield: defense, aggro up.

skills.name: Shield Throw
skills.description: Hurls the shield flat across the room, edge first.
skills.shortDescription: Throws the shield for ranged damage.

skills.name: Rally
skills.description: A shout that carries to the back of the line, and the line closes up behind it.
skills.shortDescription: Lowers party fear, boosts team attack for 1 turn.

skills.name: Heavy Charge
skills.description: Lowers the shoulder and goes through the enemy line as though it were a door.
skills.shortDescription: Charges the enemy group for area damage.

skills.name: Sword Judgment
skills.description: A single stroke with the whole weight of the blade behind it, and no thought of a second.
skills.shortDescription: A heavy sword strike. Always hits.

passiveSkill.name: Bulwark
passiveSkill.description: Years on the front line have hardened more than just the shield arm.

name: Mage
description: Ends a fight quickly with fire, lightning and ice, and cannot take a hit in return. Keep something solid in front of it.

skills.name: Arcane Bolt
skills.description: A weak bolt of raw arcane force — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: A weak arcane bolt — basic damage.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: A ball of fire thrown from the palm, still turning as it goes.
skills.shortDescription: A fireball; may set the target Burning.

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.description: A bolt of lightning out of a clear patch of ceiling, and the smell of it arrives after.
skills.shortDescription: A fast bolt; may cause Stunned.

skills.name: Fire Pillar
skills.description: Raises a pillar of fire from the floor, and the enemy line stands in it.
skills.shortDescription: Burns the group, high chance to Burn.

skills.name: Lightning Storm
skills.description: Draws a storm in under the ceiling, and every enemy in the room hears it before it breaks.
skills.shortDescription: Storm hits all enemies, may cause Stunned.

skills.name: Ice Age
skills.description: Frost crosses the floor and climbs every wall, and the torch flames lean away from it.
skills.shortDescription: Wide frost damage. Always hits.

passiveSkill.name: Arcane Shred
passiveSkill.description: Every bolt that lands leaves the target's wards a little thinner than the last.

name: Rogue
description: Moves before almost anyone else, drops one target hard, and is already gone before it can hit back.

skills.name: Stab
skills.description: Stabs with a dagger — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: Stabs with a dagger — basic damage.

skills.name: Poison Coat
skills.description: Draws the blade through a poisoned rag and does not wipe it clean.
skills.shortDescription: Coats the blade: hits also poison.

skills.name: Knife Throw
skills.description: A knife thrown underhand, from the hip, with no wind-up to warn anyone.
skills.shortDescription: Throws a dagger for ranged damage.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.description: A stab from the one place the target is not looking.
skills.shortDescription: A vicious blind-spot stab, high damage.

skills.name: Poison Bomb
skills.description: A clay bomb thrown into the middle of the enemy, and the smoke goes where it likes.
skills.shortDescription: Poisons every enemy at once.

skills.name: Flurry Assault
skills.description: Cut after cut, too close together to count, and the dagger is back at the hip.
skills.shortDescription: 3 rapid stabs. Always hits.

passiveSkill.name: Venomcraft
passiveSkill.description: Knows exactly where the poison is already working, and where to add to it.

name: Acolyte
description: Keeps the party's wounds closed and its nerve steady when the floors turn ugly.

skills.name: Smite
skills.description: A flicker of borrowed light — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: A flicker of borrowed light — basic damage.

skills.name: Prayer
skills.description: A short prayer, spoken low, and the shaking in the hands stops.
skills.shortDescription: Lowers 1 ally's fear and raises their defense.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: A hand laid on the wound until it closes.
skills.shortDescription: Restores HP to 1 ally.

skills.name: Purify
skills.description: Holy light that lifts the rot from a friend and burns through an enemy.
skills.shortDescription: Cures an ally's debuff, or smites an enemy.

skills.name: Mass Heal
skills.description: A blessing spoken over the whole party; wounds close and breathing slows.
skills.shortDescription: Heals and calms the whole party.

skills.name: Divine Descent
skills.description: Light comes down through a ceiling that was never open, and wounds on one side of the room close while the other side goes white.
skills.shortDescription: Holy light: heals allies, smites foes.

passiveSkill.name: Devotion
passiveSkill.description: Curses slide off it, and its blessings land heavier.

name: Viking
description: Trades safety for numbers — puts everything behind every swing and hopes the fight's over before its own HP is.

skills.name: Axe Slash
skills.description: An axe slash — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: An axe slash — basic damage.

skills.name: Lightning Axe
skills.description: Holds the axe up to the storm, and the storm answers through the handle.
skills.shortDescription: Lightning-charges the axe for a few turns.

skills.name: Frenzied Slash
skills.description: A slash with no guard behind it, thrown wide and wild.
skills.shortDescription: A wild slash, may cause Bleeding.

skills.name: Throw Axe
skills.description: The axe leaves the hand end over end and does not slow down.
skills.shortDescription: Throws the axe for ranged damage.

skills.name: Spinning Axe
skills.description: Turns on the spot with the axe at arm's length, and the whole enemy line is in reach.
skills.shortDescription: Spins the axe through the enemy group.

skills.name: Thunder God's Fury
skills.description: Calls the storm in through the roof and lets it find every enemy in the room.
skills.shortDescription: Unleashes the storm's full fury on all foes.

passiveSkill.name: Blood Fury
passiveSkill.description: The closer death gets, the harder the swing.

name: Plague Doctor
description: Doesn't need the first hit to win — poison, blindness, and toxic fog do the work over time, and it can patch the team up when nobody else can.

skills.name: Vial Toss
skills.description: Tosses a crude vial — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: A crude vial toss — basic damage.

skills.name: Fire Vial
skills.description: A vial of alchemist's fire, thrown with the cork still smoking.
skills.shortDescription: Alchemical fire — possibly setting foe ablaze.

skills.name: Healing Draught
skills.description: A draught held to the lips of the wounded, bitter all the way down.
skills.shortDescription: Heals 1 ally now and over 2 turns.

skills.name: Blinding Vial
skills.description: Caustic powder broken at the enemy's feet, and it rises to the eyes.
skills.shortDescription: Caustic powder; possibly blinding the target.

skills.name: Spreading Toxic Fog
skills.description: A fog that rolls out of the flask thick and low, and finds every enemy in the group.
skills.shortDescription: Toxic fog: possibly poisoning or weakening foes.

skills.name: Total Plague
skills.description: Breaks every vial at once and stands in the cloud it makes, untouched.
skills.shortDescription: Heals allies, poisons and burns foes.

passiveSkill.name: Contagion
passiveSkill.description: Every touch carries something new — the body just hasn't noticed yet.

name: Archer
description: Every shot is built to land hard — high crit odds, an ambush shot that fires the instant something moves on it, and hits that leave the target weaker for whoever swings next.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.description: A bow shot — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: A bow shot — basic damage.

skills.name: Aimed Shot
skills.description: A shot taken slowly, with the string held and the breath held with it.
skills.shortDescription: An aimed shot, likely to crit.

skills.name: Overwatch
skills.description: Settles the bow on the room and stays still, string drawn, until something moves.
skills.shortDescription: Fires the instant an enemy moves.

skills.name: Volley Shot
skills.description: Arrows loosed in a high arc, and they come down on the whole enemy group.
skills.shortDescription: A volley of arrows over the enemy group.

skills.name: Crippling Shot
skills.description: A shot placed through the joint, where the armour is only strap.
skills.shortDescription: Joint shot, may weaken defense.

skills.name: Deadeye Shot
skills.description: Holds the string a breath longer than any other shot, then lets it go.
skills.shortDescription: A perfect, guaranteed critical shot.

passiveSkill.name: Deadly Precision
passiveSkill.description: A breath held before every release, however small the target.

name: Ninja
description: Isn't built to overpower anything — disappear from the fight entirely, let a decoy clone take the hits instead, and let bleeding pile up until a finishing strike closes it out.

skills.name: Kunai Strike
skills.description: A kunai stab — basic damage.
skills.shortDescription: A kunai stab — basic damage.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: A pellet cracked underfoot, and by the time the smoke clears there is no one to look at.
skills.shortDescription: Vanishes, untargetable until it strikes.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.description: Cuts once, then steps out of its own shadow and leaves it standing in the way.
skills.shortDescription: Light strike that leaves a decoy clone.

skills.name: Throwing Knives
skills.description: Knives thrown in a quick spread, small enough to be missed until they land.
skills.shortDescription: Thrown knives, may cause Bleeding.

skills.name: Shuriken Storm
skills.description: A handful of shuriken thrown into the air all at once, and they come down on the whole group.
skills.shortDescription: Showers foes with shuriken, may cause Bleeding.

skills.name: Death Mark
skills.description: Finds the place where a body is already coming apart, and puts the blade there.
skills.shortDescription: A vital strike, harder vs a low-HP foe.

passiveSkill.name: Afterimage
passiveSkill.description: Never quite where the strike lands, and sometimes a second shadow stands up to answer for it.

name: Summoner
description: Barely fights with its own hands — it summons something to take the hits, someone to patch the party up, and whatever's left over to hit back, each one shaped in its own image.

skills.name: Hollow Pulse
skills.description: A dull pulse drawn from the totem's hollow — basic damage. The Summoner leans on its minions, not its own combat.
skills.shortDescription: A dull pulse from the totem — basic damage.

skills.name: Summon Goblin
skills.description: A goblin steps out of the totem's shadow, thin and fast, a stone already in its hand.
skills.shortDescription: Summons a ranged Goblin Thrower.

skills.name: Summon Spirit
skills.description: Calls a pale spirit out of the air, and it goes to whoever is bleeding.
skills.shortDescription: Summons a Healer Spirit for the party.

skills.name: Summon Golem
skills.description: Pulls a golem up out of the floor, slow and heavy, and every enemy in the room turns to look at it.
skills.shortDescription: Summons a high-HP, high-aggro Golem.

skills.name: Totem Recall
skills.description: Plants a totem that channels strength into the whole party, until something breaks it.
skills.shortDescription: Plants a totem buffing the party.

skills.name: Summon Hellfire Imp
skills.description: Pulls an imp up out of some other hearth, and it arrives already burning everything in sight.
skills.shortDescription: Summons an Imp, scorches every foe.

passiveSkill.name: Bound Legion
passiveSkill.description: The pact deepens on its own, and makes room for more minions at the Summoner's side.
